note: JustZombies isometric art (CC0, see CREDITS.md). Re-render with tools/trash-art-render.

tile.note: one ground tile is a 1.6 m square, drawn as a 128 x 64 diamond

projection.worldToScreen: tiles (tx, ty) -> screen: sx = (tx - ty) * 64, sy = (tx + ty) * 32; a height of z metres rises z * 48.99 px (pxPerMetre * cos 30)
projection.light: one rig for everything: warm key light from the screen top-left, sky/ground hemisphere fill, cool back fill; soft cast shadows baked into each frame

directions.names: screen directions: S = toward the bottom of the screen (facing the viewer), E = screen right, N = away from the viewer
directions.mirrorHow: draw the mirrored source row flipped horizontally; anchor x becomes (cell w - anchor x)
directions.pick: with world velocity (vx, vy) in tile axes: sx = vx - vy, sy = (vx + vy) / 2; dir = ["E","SE","S","SW","W","NW","N","NE"][Math.round(Math.atan2(sy, sx) / (Math.PI / 4)) & 7]

frames.layout: atlases are grids of cell-sized frames: x = frame * cell[0], y = anims[name].rows[dir] * cell[1]
frames.anchor: anchor = the ground point under the object (feet / footprint centre) inside one cell; put it on the projected world position
frames.scale: draw at scale * (your tile width / 128). Pickups and weapons are rendered at 2x detail (scale 0.5)
frames.pickups: pickups/weapons have one 8-frame "spin" anim (turntable); bob them in code
frames.death: death plays once; hold the last frame (corpse + blood pool) then fade
